# TechNext (TechNext Pte. Ltd., Singapore)

> TechNext Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based Odoo Ready Partner. We implement Odoo ERP end to end (accounting, sales, inventory, POS, HR and more), build enterprise AI (RAG knowledge assistants, AI inside Odoo, workflow automation agents, chatbots), run websites and social media, and deliver IoT, app development and network services for growing companies.

- Registered name: TechNext Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202699888G)
- Headquarters: 261 Waterloo Street #03-36, Singapore 180261
- Philippines development hub: Level 9, IP Center, Taguig City, Metro Manila
- Vietnam AI engineering hub: 62 Nguyễn Thị Nhung, Phường Hiệp Bình, Ho Chi Minh City
- Contact: sales@technext.asia · WhatsApp +65 8839 6998
- Clients in 10+ countries; 11+ enterprise clients; 4 core AI disciplines
- Odoo partner tier: Odoo Ready Partner (listing: https://www.odoo.com/partners/technext-pte-ltd-28073844)
- Focus apps: Accounting, Sales and Inventory first; the rest of the Odoo suite as the business needs it
- Method: discovery, configuration on a staging copy, data migration, training, integration, support
- Hosting: Odoo Online, Odoo.sh or on-premise, chosen during discovery
- Pricing: Odoo licences are priced per user per month by Odoo; TechNext quotes implementation in writing
- Written quotation: https://technext.asia/quotation
